stories.headline: AI-discovered bugs compress cyber response time
stories.summary: Experts say AI has doubled the pace of vulnerability discovery and can help create exploits in hours. More flaws do not automatically mean successful attacks, but defenders may face repeated urgent patching cycles.

stories.headline: AI spending fears trigger broad tech selloff
stories.summary: The Nasdaq fell 2.6% as investors questioned returns from heavy AI infrastructure spending. Meta lost 7% after reporting negative free cash flow and plans for new non-voting shares; long-term outcomes remain uncertain.

stories.headline: DOJ escalates California ballot dispute
stories.summary: The Justice Department asked an appeals court to intervene before a trial judge rules on its request to block more than 20,000 mail ballots pending citizenship checks. California has not conceded DOJ's allegations.

stories.headline: Putin rejects a short-term Ukraine ceasefire
stories.summary: Putin said renewed talks should produce final security arrangements for Russia, Ukraine and Europe rather than a temporary ceasefire. US-led diplomacy has restarted, but no agreement or negotiating timetable is settled.

stories.headline: Typhoon Champi shuts down Taiwan
stories.summary: Taiwan closed most schools, offices and markets and cancelled nearly 1,000 flights as Champi approached. One person died, 163 were injured and more than 2,600 evacuated; landfall remained possible.
